# Syntax

Inline `code`, a table, and task lists:

| feature | status |
|---------|--------|
| table   | yes    |
| task    | yes    |

- [x] done item
- [ ] todo item

A Rust block:

```rust
fn main() {
    println!("hello, trans-epub");
}
```

An unknown language stays plain:

```brainfuck
+++[->+++<]>++.
```

A long line for wrap checks:

```text
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
```
